name: Change request created
description: Registrant email and SMS when a change request is created.

controlValues.subject: We received your change request for {{payload.record_name}}

controlValues.body: Change request received for {{payload.record_name}}. We will message you when it is approved or rejected.

name: Change request approved
description: Registrant email and SMS when a change request is approved.

controlValues.subject: Your change request for {{payload.record_name}} was approved

controlValues.body: Approved: your change request for {{payload.record_name}} is now complete.

name: Change request rejected
description: Registrant email and SMS when a change request is rejected.

controlValues.subject: Your change request for {{payload.record_name}} was not approved

controlValues.body: Not approved: change request for {{payload.record_name}}.{% if payload.rejection_reason %} Reason: {{payload.rejection_reason}}.{% endif %}

description: Registrant email and SMS when an intake application is approved.
